primer: TORPC tier-2. Numbers are ALREADY DECIMAL (NOT hex); events/functions are DECODED with named args (e.g. {event:"Transfer", args:{from,to,value}}); field names are compacted.

questions.prompt: How many transactions are in this block?
What is the total gas used by this block, as a decimal integer?
What is the base fee per gas of this block, in wei as a decimal integer?
What is the miner / fee-recipient address of this block?
